description: This Java class defines CustomerCriteria, a data model for customer search or filtering parameters extending a generic Criteria class.

classes.name: CustomerCriteria
classes.description: A class that extends Criteria to encapsulate customer filtering attributes such as first name, last name, email, etc.

methods.description: Returns the first name filter criterion.
